brand.splashSub: The pilot endcap: every product opens Cola Run, live at evade.medialife.ai.

product.label: BOBO Cap
product.description: Bobo's signature look as a real cap, with a woven NFC label under the brim.

product.label: Cat Bobo Plush
product.description: Cat Bobo, the hero of Cola Run, as a 28 cm plush with an NFC chip in the tush tag.
product.trigger: NFC chip in the tush tag

product.label: EVADE Activated Keychain
product.description: The launch-ready pilot product: acrylic Bobo and Eclipse Cola charms with an NFC tag and a QR on the back. One tap opens Cola Run, the exclusive mini-game, and unlocks an in-game UGC item (subject to final approval).
product.trigger: NFC tag + QR on the charm back

product.label: EVADE Desk Mat
product.description: XL desk mat printed with the Cola Run key art. The QR is part of the artwork.

product.label: Eclipse Cola Collectible
product.description: Eclipse Cola cans straight from Cola Run, as spinning collectibles. Each can carries a QR under the tab.

product.label: EVADE Activated Tee
product.description: The pilot's second SKU: heavyweight black tee with the EVADE mark and Bobo, plus an NFC care label. A tap opens the same Cola Run drop.

product.label: Cat Bobo Hoodie
product.description: The navy hoodie Cat Bobo wears, with cat ears on the hood and the EVADE mark. Owning it unlocks the matching avatar hoodie.

tour.title: Stop them in the aisle
tour.body: A 3.84 m Walmart endcap built from modular lightbox towers, a channel-letter header and a 12-tile video wall. It reads from the end of the aisle, and every surface either sells or activates.

tour.title: Tell the property's story
tour.body: The same fixture re-skins for any Roblox-native IP. Here it's EVADE, the first pilot property: its key art, its characters and its merch.

tour.title: Merchandise that extends the IP
tour.body: The pilot EVADE keychain and tee, plus the Cat Bobo plush, the BOBO cap, a hoodie, a desk mat and Eclipse Cola collectibles. Tap any product and it comes off the shelf.

tour.title: Tap, play, unlock
tour.body: The QR on the right tower is real: scan it with your phone and Cola Run opens at evade.medialife.ai. No app. A mini-game, a reveal, then a UGC reward redeemed inside EVADE.

tour.title: Back to Roblox, and measured
tour.body: Unique activations, repeat interactions, engagement time and outbound traffic to Roblox, reported by location, property and creative treatment. This is the data behind the 90-day program review.

tour.title: Built modular
tour.body: Six modules bolt together on site: two lightbox towers, the header, the video wall, the merch bay and the plinth, plus a freestanding digital totem. When the featured property changes, you swap graphics, not fixtures.
